correctness.rationale: The all-n exact equation follows by central Jucys–Murphy eigenvalues, triple character orthogonality, standard permutation module Ind_{S_(n-1)}^{S_n}(1)-1, multiplicity-free Young branching and exact dimension identities. The standard Lindblad mode multiplier is e^{-2gamma t/(n-1)}. Conditional Plancherel transition measures converge in probability weakly to the semicircle by limit shape plus Kerov continuity; bounded Fourier transforms give expectation-square convergence to [J1(4s)/(2s)]^2. The n=2 boundary and s=0 are covered. The extracted verifier checks 59 finite identities, but finite tests are not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The standard irreducible coefficient governs the slowest classical random-transposition harmonic, identified by the motivating paper; prior variance estimates only identify an n^{3/2} scale. The exact all-n branching form gives a tractable positive-mean formula and its nonmonotone Bessel-square profile with asymptotic zeros; in the joint weak-dissipation regime it furnishes the quantitative open-system crossover. Neither a paper-scale general theorem nor an assertion about total variation is required for the model-motivated sharp mode result.
